Pay Level

Age Limit (as on 01.01.2027)

Additional Hockey norms (including specified international and Senior National results) are given in the detailed notification.

✅ RRC WR Sports Quota 2026 Selection Process:

All eligible candidates will be called for trial. Only candidates declared FIT in trial (25 or more marks out of 40 for game skill, physical fitness and coach’s observation) will be assessed further.

  • Assessment of Sports Achievements and Educational Qualification
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination

Distribution of marks: Recognised sports achievements – 50 marks; Game skill, physical fitness and coach’s observation during trials – 40 marks; Educational qualification – 10 marks (Total 100). Minimum qualifying marks: Level-5/4 – 70, Level-3/2 – 65, Level-1 – 60. Merit will decide appointment. In case of a tie, the younger candidate will get preference.

✅ Western Railway Sports Quota 2026 Application Fee:

  • General / OBC and other candidates: ₹500/- (₹400/- refundable after appearing in the trial, subject to eligibility, after bank charges)
  • SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen / PwBD / Women / Minorities / Economically Backward Class: ₹250/- (full fee refundable after appearing in the trial, subject to eligibility, after bank charges)
  • Payment Method: Online only through Debit Card / Credit Card / Internet Banking / UPI. Applications without fee will be rejected.

Eligible candidates must apply online only through the RRC Western Railway website. No other mode of application will be accepted. The steps are as follows:

  • Step 1: Visit www.rrc-wr.com and open the Sports Quota online application link for Employment Notice No. RRC/WR/01/2026.
  • Step 2: Register with a valid mobile number and email ID. Keep your 12-digit Aadhaar number ready (or 28-digit Aadhaar enrolment ID if the card is not yet received).

  • RRB ALP (Assistant Loco Pilot): For the recruitment of assistant loco pilots.
  • RRB Paramedical: For various paramedical posts in Indian Railways.

  • RPF Sub-Inspector: For higher-level positions in the Railway Protection Force (RPF) and Railway Protection Special Force (RPSF).
  • RRB Ministerial and Isolated Categories: For various ministerial posts and isolated categories.

✅ Railway Job Vacancy 2026-27 List:

  • General Recruitment: Open to all candidates based on merit, involving various exams conducted by Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs).
  • Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST) Quota: Reserved seats for SC/ST candidates, providing benefits like age relaxation and a lower cut-off mark.
  • Other Backward Classes (OBC) Quota: Reserved positions for OBC candidates, with similar benefits as SC/ST.
  • Ex-Servicemen Quota: Positions reserved for individuals who have served in the armed forces, including age relaxations.
  • Sports Quota: Recruitment based on outstanding achievements in sports, requiring candidates to meet specific criteria.
  • Meritorious Sports Persons: Special recruitment opportunities for athletes with exceptional records at national or international levels.
  • Persons with Disabilities (PwD) Quota: Reservations for candidates with physical disabilities, along with additional advantages.
  • Divyang Quota: Specific provisions for different types of disabilities during the recruitment process.
  • Nursing Quota: Reserved for candidates with nursing qualifications, especially in paramedical roles.
  • Culture Quota: For individuals with notable contributions in cultural fields, allowing them to apply for specific positions.
  • Group 'A' Posts: These posts are filled through examinations conducted by UPSC, including the Civil Services Exam, Engineering Services Exam, and Combined Medical Services Examination.
  • Group 'B' Posts: These posts are not open for direct recruitment. Group 'B' positions are linked to Section Officers' Grade, which are upgraded roles for Group 'C' railway employees on a deputation basis.
  • Group 'C' Posts: This category includes both technical and non-technical positions, such as Clerk, Station Master, Ticket Collector, Commercial Apprentice, Traffic Apprentice, and various engineering roles (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Signal & Telecommunication), among others.
  • Group 'D' Posts: The Positions in this group cover various disciplines, including Trackman, Helper, Assistant Points Man, Safaiwala/Safaiwali, Gunman, and Peon.
  • Other Posts: This includes ITI Apprentices, Sports Quota, Cultural Quota, Scouts and Guides Quota, and more.

✅ Frequently Asked Questions:

What are the jobs in the Railway Sector?

Indian Railway jobs include Gazetted (Group 'A' and 'B'), Non-Gazetted (Group 'C' and 'D'), NTPC, Junior Engineer, RPF, RPSF, Act Apprentices, Level 1, and Level 2 posts.

How to apply for railway recruitment through rozgardwaar.com?

The rozgardwaar.com blog frequently updates the latest Indian Railway jobs. Eligible candidates should first check qualification-based railway job listings, then click on a specific Railway Name for detailed notifications and application links.

What are the qualifications for railway jobs?

Minimum qualifications include passing the 10th class or ITI for Group C & D posts, and holding a Graduate or Post Graduate degree for Group A & B posts.

How many railway zones are there in India?

There are 21 Railway Zones in India: Ahmedabad, Ajmer, Allahabad, Bangalore, Bhopal, Bhubaneshwar, Bilaspur, Chandigarh, Chennai, Gorakhpur, Guwahati, Jammu, Kolkata, Malda, Mumbai, Muzaffarpur, Patna, Ranchi, Secunderabad, Siliguri, and Trivandrum.

How many types of railway jobs are there?

Group 'A' Posts: Appointed through UPSC exams. Group 'B' Posts: Upgraded posts from Group 'C' employees. Group 'C' Posts: Technical and Non-Technical cadre posts. Group 'D' Posts: Various discipline posts including Trackman, Helper, etc. Other Posts: ITI Apprentices, Sports Quota, etc.

Which is the best job in the Railway?

The best job depends on individual qualifications and preferences. For 10th or 12th pass candidates, popular posts include Clerk, Station Master, and Ticket Collector, while engineers may prefer Group A Engineering Services.

How many jobs are there in the Indian Railways?

Each year, more than one lakh vacancies open up in the Railway sector.

Is a career in the railway possible after 12th?

Yes, individuals who have passed the 10th or 12th standard are eligible to apply for Group C and Group D railway posts.

Who is eligible to apply for railway jobs?

Indian citizens who have passed at least Matriculation/10th standard are eligible to apply. Strong technical skills are also preferred.

Why does rozgardwaar.com have a Railway Jobs list page?

The page provides weekly updates for job seekers looking for railway jobs and offers free alerts for railway job opportunities.

FAQs

What are the eligibility criteria for government teacher vacancy 2026 in India?

Candidates must possess a Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed or D.Ed), Bachelor of Education (B.Ed), or Master of Education (M.Ed). For most teaching positions in primary and upper-primary classes (Class 1 to 8), it is mandatory to qualify in the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) or the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET). Additionally, subject-specific qualifications are required for Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) and Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) posts.

How many teacher vacancies are expected in government schools in 2026-2027?

More than 50,000 teaching vacancies are expected to be announced across central and state government schools during 2026-2027. These openings include both regular and contractual positions in primary, secondary, and higher secondary levels, covering institutions such as Kendriya Vidyalaya, Navodaya Vidyalaya, Sainik Schools, and various government-aided schools.

Is CTET or State TET compulsory for sarkari teacher bharti 2026?

Yes, in most cases it is compulsory. State education boards generally require candidates to clear the respective State Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) for teaching positions from Classes 1 to 8. For central government schools like Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS) and Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), qualification in CTET is usually mandatory. However, some recruitment notifications may accept either CTET or State TET.

What types of teaching posts are available in government teacher recruitment 2026?

A wide range of teaching and related posts are commonly available, including Primary Teacher (PRT), Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT), Post Graduate Teacher (PGT), Principal, Special Educator, Art/Music/Craft Teacher, and Librarian. In some institutions, non-teaching support roles such as Lab Assistant and Ward Boy are also advertised alongside teaching vacancies.

How can I apply for upcoming government teacher jobs 2026?

Applications for these positions are submitted online through the official recruitment portals of the concerned organisations. These include websites of individual Sainik Schools, state Public Service Commissions (PSC), Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS), Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), and other relevant bodies. Always refer to the official notification for the exact application link, required documents, application fee details, and the last date for submission. Make sure to apply well before the deadline mentioned in the notification.Which organisations release the most government teaching vacancies in India?
The major organisations that regularly release a large number of government teaching vacancies include Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS), Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), Sainik Schools, Rashtriya Military Schools, various state Public Service Commissions (such as Kerala PSC, UPPSC, and BPSC), and respective state education departments.

What is the salary range for government teachers in India?

The salary for government teachers varies depending on the post, state or central recruitment, and pay level under the 7th Pay Commission. Typically, Primary Teachers (PRT) start at around ₹35,000 to ₹45,000 per month, Trained Graduate Teachers (TGT) earn between ₹44,000 and ₹57,000, and Post Graduate Teachers (PGT) receive ₹47,000 to ₹62,000 per month (including allowances). Teachers in central government schools often enjoy higher pay scales and additional benefits compared to state-level positions.

Where can I find the latest notifications for teacher vacancy 2026?

To stay updated with the latest recruitment notifications for teacher vacancies in 2026, regularly visit the official websites of Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS), Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), Sainik Schools Society, respective state education departments, and reliable job portals such as rozgardwaar.com. These sources provide direct application links and the most current information.

About High Courts in India

The High Courts of India are the principal civil courts of original jurisdiction in each state and union territory. The High Courts are the highest courts of appellate jurisdiction in each state. Total 25 High courts available in India, include five oldest high courts are Calcutta High Court in Kolkata, Bombay High Court, Madras High Court, Allahabad High Court, and Bangalore High Court. The High Court's offers career opportunity for both Male and Female Law Professionals, Graduates, Diploma, ITI and 10th 12th Pass candidates.

Types of High Court Job Vacancies

✔️ Judicial / Law Positions:

High Court Judges: These are appointed by the President of India, after consultation with the Chief Justice of India and the Governor of the respective state. The eligibility criteria include a minimum of ten years of experience as an advocate or a judicial officer in India.

District Judges: Selection is through a competitive examination conducted by the respective High Court. Candidates typically need to have a law degree and a certain number of years of experience in legal practice.

✔️ Administrative Positions:

Registrars: Responsible for administrative management of the court. Requires experience in judicial service or equivalent administrative service.

Assistant Registrars: Assist the Registrars in managing court operations. Often promoted from lower administrative positions.

✔️ Support Staff:

Clerks and Assistants: Handle clerical work including maintaining records and assisting in court proceedings. Requires a bachelor’s degree and proficiency in computer operations.

Stenographers: Transcribe court proceedings. Requires proficiency in shorthand and typing, along with a relevant diploma or certificate.

Frequently Asked Questions:

Who can apply for High Court Recruitment 2025?

High Court Recruitment 2025 is open to both fresher and experienced Indian candidates. The High Courts offer career opportunities for male and female law professionals, graduates, diploma holders, ITI holders, and candidates who have passed 10th or 12th grade.

How many High Courts are there in India?

There are a total of 25 High Courts in India. The five oldest High Courts are the Calcutta High Court in Kolkata, Bombay High Court, Madras High Court, Allahabad High Court, and Bangalore High Court.

Are High Court jobs considered government jobs?

Yes, High Court job vacancies are 100% central government jobs. Employees of the High Courts are considered government employees and enjoy the benefits and responsibilities associated with government service.

✅ Top State Government Jobs Categories:

  • State Civil Services: Similar to the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) at the central level, state civil services include positions like State Administrative Service, State Police Service, and State Forest Service.
  • State Police Jobs: State police departments recruit for various positions such as Sub-Inspectors, Constables, Jailer, Fireman and Deputy Superintendents of Police (DSPs).
  • Teaching Jobs: State governments hire teachers for primary and secondary education in state-run schools. Positions include Primary Teachers (PRT), School Assistant, Trained Graduate Teachers (TGT), and Post Graduate Teachers (PGT).
  •  Healthcare Jobs: State Health Departments hire medical professionals such as Doctors, Nurses, Pharmacists, Technician, Para Medical Staffs and healthcare staff for state-run hospitals and Medical Institutions.
  • Engineering Jobs: Various state government departments and public sector undertakings (PSUs) recruit engineers for roles in civil, mechanical, electrical, and other engineering disciplines.
  • Revenue and Taxation: State revenue departments hire officers for roles related to revenue collection and taxation.
  • Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs): State-owned PSUs, such as state electricity boards, transport corporations, and housing boards, offer job opportunities in various sectors.
  • Agriculture and Rural Development: State Agriculture and Rural Development Departments hire professionals to promote agriculture and rural development.
  • State Transport Services: State transport corporations recruit drivers, conductors, and other staff for public transportation services.
  • State Judiciary: State Judicial Services conduct exams to recruit Judicial Officers, Court Assistant, Steno, District Judges and Magistrates.
  • State Forest and Wildlife Services: State Forest Departments hire professionals (Forester, Forest Ranger etc.) for roles related to forest conservation and wildlife protection.
  • State Public Service Commissions (PSCs): State PSCs conduct exams for a variety of state government positions. Each state has its own PSC responsible for recruitment.
  • State Education Departments: Besides teaching positions, state education departments also hire administrative and support staff for educational institutions.
  • Social Welfare and Women Empowerment: Various state departments work on social welfare programs, women's empowerment, and child welfare, offering job opportunities in these areas.
